lines.369680625057738757: BUT! I still got something that'll make your day.
lines.369680625066127360: A taped interview between him and the Sheriff.
lines.369680625066127361: You get this door open and the tape is yours, okay?
lines.369680625066127362: What happened here, what happened to your face?
lines.369680625070321664: You're the detective, what does it look like to you?
lines.369680625070321665: Looks like a deputy locked up in his own interrogation room.
lines.369680625070321667: That's fine, if you don't want to talk, I can just leave.
lines.369680625074515968: You ever lose control detective? You ever do something that you regret later?
lines.369680625074515970: It doesn't matter, you need this tape, so just get the door open.
lines.369680625074515971: I've got the Eddie tape right here, detective.  Just get that door open.
lines.369680625078710272: Unlock the door, get the tape. It's a fair trade.
lines.369680625078710273: You really have it in for this Eddie guy, uh?
lines.369680625078710274: I've been hired to find him. That's all.
lines.369680625082904576: If that was true you'd have taken my advice when we first met and and made yourself scarce.
lines.369680625082904577: Must be desperate. I can smell it on you.
lines.369680625082904579: Go on, the tape's yours. I won't stop you.
lines.369680625087098880: Don't you have somewhere to be?
lines.369680625087098881: I'm stuck in this storm, same as you.
lines.369680625087098882: I'll be out before it hits.
lines.369680625087098883: It's already here, you just can't see it.
lines.369680625087098884: You're nuts, you know that Roberts.
lines.369680625099681795: Maybe he did, maybe he didn’t. Who gives a shit.
lines.369680625103876096: Eddie is a bastard any way you look at him.
lines.369680625103876097: Same as me. Same as you.
lines.369680625103876098: I know you can feel it. The change coming.

lines.369680625166790658: You killed that girl, didn’t you?
lines.369680625170984960: Yeah you did. It’s time for you to pay.
lines.369680625170984961: Now listen, I had nothing to do with that! I’m telling you, you’ve got the wrong guy! –
